role: Declares the CoachReportGenerator namespace whose sentence builders (in +Conversational / +Sections) produce the template-based post-workout Coach Report email body; holds the PDF footnote.
types: CoachReportGenerator: enum — template (non-AI) coach email body generator
toplevel: Doc comment says the generator is honest about missing data ('no HRR captured' rather than a fabricated value); no code in the extension emits such a line (recoveryParagraph returns nil instead).

units.does: Returns the localized closing footnote ('---' + italic note that the attached PDF is the source of truth) appended to the email body only when the PDF attachment exists.
